mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, negatively affecting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) over the last two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when real estate activity increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate output and earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when industrial production decreases by more than 1% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in the last month, it indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the unemployment rate is below 5% and payroll employment increases by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the last two months, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in the same period, signals a robust consumer demand environment, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when retail sales increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it indicates an inflationary pressure environment, leading to tighter monetary policy and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter, coupled with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in the last two months, indicates a supply-side constraint environment, leading to increased costs and reduced corporate margins, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDP increases and industrial production decreases by more than 0.5% in the last two months.
